The stderr reader now returns at EOF after processing the final line. A regression test checks failed initialisation, process exit, client registration, and reader termination. ### Changes **Startup cleanup** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Client cleanup and stderr termination**
`internal/daemon/daemon.go`, `internal/daemon/daemon_test.go`|`startMCPServer` closes the client if startup exits before registration. Registered clients are not closed by this deferred cleanup. The stderr reader returns after processing the final line at EOF. The test checks that failed initialisation leaves no registered client, stops the child process, and ends the stderr-reader goroutine.| Suggested reviewers: `peteski22` Change: Bug fix · **Severity of issue fixed:** Medium
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to 7c4cd

When an MCP server fails to initialise, the daemon now closes the spawned process before returning, which addresses the orphaned-process report. A child that ignores shutdown signals could still outlive the daemon if the shutdown timeout expires first, but that matches how shutdown already behaves. No merge-blocking risk remains.

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: the daemon now closes the MCP client when a server fails to start. It matches the summary, which adds a deferred close to startMCPServer on pre-registration failures, and the linked issue `#354` on orphaned child processes. The conventional commit prefix is clear and the title is concise.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the repository template. It explains the cause (the client is not registered before Initialize, so neither stopMCPServer nor closeAllClients reaches it), the fix (a deferred close using closeClientWithTimeout and clientShutdownTimeout), and the EOF change in the stderr reader. It links Fixes `#354`, checks the Bug Fix type, and describes the test and the verification run. It also records AI usage. Two items remain open: the local checks box (make lint, make test) is unchecked, and the description does not say that golangci-lint was skipped in the checklist context beyond the body text. These are minor, so the description is mostly complete.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#354`] The issue asks that a failed server start after spawning the child process close the client, because an unregistered server is unreachable from stopMCPServer and closeAllClients. The diff to internal/daemon/daemon.go at the reviewed head adds a deferred cleanup right after the process is started. The cleanup calls d.closeClientWithTimeout(server.Name(), stdioClient, d.clientShutdownTimeout) unless a registered flag is set. The flag is set to true only after clientManager.Add and healthTracker.Add succeed. This covers the GetStderr failure path and the Initialize failure path named in the issue. The stderr reader goroutine now returns on io.EOF, which lets the reader finish once the client closes. The summary reports a fake uvx test (skipped on Windows) that checks the process exits and the reader goroutine finishes. I did not read daemon_test.go, so the test result rests on the summary and the author's report, not on code I inspected. The code change meets the issue's coding requirement.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The reviewed diff for internal/daemon/daemon.go changes only startMCPServer. The deferred close, the registered flag, and the io.EOF return all serve the orphaned-process fix described in `#354`. The added test in internal/daemon/daemon_test.go, per the summary, checks that same behaviour. No unrelated changes were found in the inspected code. The test file was not inspected directly, so this result does not cover its contents beyond the summary.
